 This Crl.P Is Filed U/S.482 Cr.P.C Praying To Set Aside
The Order

DATED 06.02.2018 PASSED IN THE CASE ORDERING PROCESS AGAINST THE PETITIONERS FOR OFFENCES THAT ARE MADE U/S 498A,504 AND 506 R/W 34 OF IPC, PRESUMABLY AFTER TAKING COGNIZANCE FO THE OFFENCES AND FURTHER BE PLEASED TO QUASH THE PROCEEDINGS THAT ARE BEING RECORDED IN THE CASE.

THIS CRL.P, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MRS JUSTICE M G UMA  ORAL ORDER
Learned counsel for the petitioners is absent.
No representation even when the matter is passed over twice and again called at 2.42pm.

The order sheet dated 02.09.2024 reads as under:
'' Learned counsel for the petitioners is absent.
No representation.
The learned Additional SPP submits that the petitioners have filed an application under Section 239 of Cr.P.C and the same is pending before the Trial Court.
In view of the same, the petition is not maintainable.
However, to afford final opportunity, list after two weeks. '' NC: 2024:KHC:40900
Inspite of that there is no progress in the matter.
Office objections are not complied with even though the matter is listed for 3rd time.
Hence, the petition is dismissed for non-compliance of office objections.
